rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=4, n_iter=18, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=16, lr=0.0003, batch_size=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, outer_wall_s=1080, per_scene_s=None, seed=42, rationale=dual_domain_n2i iter-4 (search-20260619-01, PER-IMAGE Noise2Inverse: warm-start pre-pass + per-scan Adam fit; NEVER amortized). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, measured from job 765337). (1) iter-3 KEEP (#5 on the Mayo board, the only N2I that CLEARED baseline): SSIM 0.9185, hr 0.1506, PSNR 35.50 vs baseline_PSNR 34.08, RMSE 8.399e-4, elapsed 1088.0s (18.1 min); fit loop 214 scenes x 15 steps = 820.7s -> 0.2557 s/per-scan-step (3.836 s/scene; ALL 214 completed inner_iters=15, NO per-scene-wall truncation since per_scene_s=1080/214=5.05s > 3.836s); fixed overhead (warm-start 4ep + setup + score + figure) = 1088.0 - 820.7 = 267.3s. TRAJECTORY: iter-1 (pe1,n15,lr1e-3) 0.8622/hr0 PSNR33.07; iter-2 (pe1->4,lr1e-3) 0.8681/hr0 PSNR32.43 (warm-start DEPTH falsified on RMSE); iter-3 (lr1e-3->3e-4) 0.9185/hr0.1506 PSNR35.50 (lr-down ANCHORED the 15-step fit near the FBP-quality warm-start init -> cleared the FBP floor). (2) OPPORTUNITY: with lr now correctly anchored at 3e-4 the per-scan fit no longer drifts off the FBP-consistent init, so MORE per-scan steps should REFINE it rather than overfit. The iter-3 fit was only 15 steps and last_loss still oscillates across scenes (3.6e-6..1.2e-5, not a flat converged floor) -> 15 may be too few to fully exploit the now-stable lr. (3) ONE KNOB: n_iter 15 -> 18 (pretrain_epochs=4, lr=3e-4, grad_clip=1.0, unet_c=16, val_n=214, seed=42, outer_wall_s=1080 ALL HELD at iter-3 -> iter-3 is the clean isolated comparison). Why n_iter=18 and NOT 25/30: the 214-scene budget HARD-CAPS n_iter at the measured 0.2557 s/step. 214-SCAN 20-MIN BUDGET MATH (HARD 20-min = 1200s compute; figure outside budget but inside the 30-min SLURM wall): fit loop = 214 x 18 x 0.2557 = 985s; + overhead 267.3s = 1252s = 20.9 min elapsed (figure-inclusive), 8.8 min under the 30-min SLURM hard-kill. n_iter=25 -> 214x25x0.2557=1368s fit -> 1635s = 27.3 min (BLOWS the 20-min budget AND risks the 30-min wall) AND at outer_wall_s=1080 the per-scene wall (5.05s) would TRUNCATE every scene at floor(5.05/0.2557)=19 steps -> a silent, non-deterministic, incomplete fit, NOT a clean n_iter=25. n_iter=18 needs 18x0.2557=4.60s/scene < the 5.05s per-scene wall -> ALL 214 scenes complete 18 steps with NO truncation, so outer_wall_s stays 1080 (no second knob; structure preserved). lr is settled (do not touch); pretrain_epochs-up was falsified at iter-2; n_iter+3 is the one in-budget, correctly-signed lever left. (4) HYPOTHESIS: n_iter 15->18 at the anchored lr=3e-4 lifts hr above iter-3's 0.1506 (PSNR above 35.50) because 3 more per-scan steps refine the FBP-consistent fit without drifting (lr is the anchor; this is the refine regime, NOT the overfit regime at n_iter 600-1200 with high lr). FALSIFIER: if hr <= 0.1506 (no PSNR gain), 15 steps already converged the per-scan fit at lr=3e-4 -> that is the per-image U-Net N2I ceiling on dense 2304-view Mayo (half-view info loss bounds hr near 0.15), and further per-scan-step tuning is futile -> iter-5 documents the ceiling (NAF/ram structural-negative class). (5) BUDGET (HARD 20-min, val=ALL 214): total 1252s = 20.9 min elapsed figure-inclusive; fit loop 985s < outer_wall_s=1080 backstop; per-scene 4.60s < per_scene_s 5.05s wall (no truncation). val_n=214 NOT reduced (protocol). 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False). staged_canonical / v3 mayo_ldct_fitted / per-sample-ps / bg_target=truth hard-wired. PER-IMAGE structure UNCHANGED (warm-start pre-pass + per-scan fit; NEVER amortized). (6) no control return.
